items.q: Then we went to the Club Harlem in Atlantic City, we had to run another trumpet player. That was Bob -- Billy Douglas from New Haven, Connecticut

ctx.x: When we left Philadelphia, we had -- we had seven. Of course, they had some terrific shows to play then. Then we went to the Club Harlem in Atlantic City, we had to run another trumpet player. That was Bob -- Billy Douglas from New Haven, Connecticut
